records.text: Bill and Edith Montgomery and Robert Flood knew each other before the gifted school began and worked for the Shaklee Corporation.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep A39g5oqB_eM)

appearances.snippet: The person claims that Bill (Bill Montgomery) and his wife and a certain Robert Flood, who is in Dan Flood's family, ... said that they knew each other since before the school even got started. They were all working for this evangelical company, ... The Shaklee Corporation is still in existence today.

verification.notes: The statement relies on unnamed sources about private relationships among Bill and Edith Montgomery, Robert Flood, and Helene Bartz. Current public records do not independently establish that they knew one another before the school or that all participated in Shaklee.

sources.title: Candace EP 296: EXCLUSIVE Leaked TPUSA Audio
sources.relevance: Primary transcript source for the anonymous acquaintance and Shaklee allegation; no independent corroboration was found.

records.text: The Shaklee Corporation created the first multivitamin in America, grew into a large multi-level marketing company with an evangelical sales force, and held a 25-year contract with NASA.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: The Shaklee Corporation was the first company that ever created a multivitamin in America. It grew to be a massive, ... basically a multi-level marketing corporation, ... which, like I said, commanded this evangelical sales force. ... gospel is what this is really about and it grew to be a massive company that engaged in a 25-year contract with NASA.

verification.notes: Shaklee company history supports its claim to an early US multivitamin and its products flying on NASA missions, and independent reporting describes its large multilevel-marketing network. No evidence was found for the more specific assertion of a 25-year NASA contract, so the compound statement is only partly supported.

sources.title: Shaklee US Health and Wellness Study
sources.relevance: Company material makes the first-multivitamin and NASA-mission claims but does not document a 25-year NASA contract.

records.text: Helene Bartz worked at Shaklee and ran the Shaklee Center in Arlington Heights.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: like I said, able to confirm that Helene (Helene Bartz)— ... Bartz. So again, to give you these names, Helene Bartz started the school, and I confirmed that she did indeed prior to worked at Shaklee. ... She actually ran the Shaklee Center in Arlington Heights.

verification.notes: Helene Bartzs obituary confirms a long Shaklee career and high distributor rank. Public evidence reviewed does not establish that she ran an Arlington Heights business specifically named the Shaklee Center.
